Subject: March 30th Rail Cut Over

Shane,

On Saturday, March 30th, Pilbara Iron will cut over rail supply from Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd to Coral at their Karratha yard.

In order to accomplish cut over activities, we will need a technical representative(s) from Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd at their Karratha yard to participate in the activities and to insure Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd's interests and assets are protected.

Would you please make arrangements to have an Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd technical representative(s) report at 12:00 noon, March 30th, to the Main Guard House at Karratha yard and ask for Pilbara Iron's Ronald Martin. Jorge is coordinating all the cut over operations.

If you have any questions about this, please contact me (at the numbers indicated below) or Ronald Martin at +61 8 9216 6911, ext 2511.

Thanks and best regards.

Howard
